summary: Full frontend validation of new Street Vybz batch (Outfit picker, Casino slots, Air One RPG shootdown, solid collisions for parked cars/buildings, melee auto-face). All 5 new features PASS. Regressions (mobile minimap, leaderboard API, game-over/restart) also pass.

test_results_detail.game_load_and_start: PASS - #startBtn (HIT THE STREETS) clickable via JS; S.running=true; 0 pageerrors; 31 npcs, 18 traffic, 64 buildings spawned
test_results_detail.outfit_picker: PASS - tryShop at S.x=-36,z=36 opens [data-testid=outfit-menu] (display:block); clicking top+hair swatches, then outfit-apply-btn deducts $50 (cash 1000->950), sets localStorage 'frasberg-streets-outfit' = {top,bottom,shoes,hair} JSON; menu hides. Reopen + outfit-close-btn also hides.
test_results_detail.casino_slots_both: PASS - Both casinos open (Lucky 7 at -18,-10 and Royal Palms at 54,10). BET $100 deducts immediately (1000->900). Reels animate through random symbols. After ~16s (Chrome headless throttles setInterval, real UX is ~1.6s = 18*90ms) result shows '🎉 WINNER +$200' and cash goes 900->1100. Close/WALK AWAY button hides slots-ui.
test_results_detail.air_one_shootdown: PASS - Set S.wanted=5; airOne spawns; equipped RPG (S.arsenal.rpg=3, S.weapon='rpg'), aimed toward heli, fireGun() -> airOne.down=true; after fast-forwarding y down, cash 1000->3500 (+2500 bonus), airOne=null, airOneCd=24.9
test_results_detail.parked_cars_solid: PASS - Teleport 0.3u inside a parked traffic entry; after 1.2s player pushed out to dist=1.48u (>=1.25); S.x/S.z remain finite. Gang car meshes (2 present) all finite (no NaN).
test_results_detail.buildings_solid: PASS - Teleporting player to buildings[0] center; after 1.8s hitsBuilding(S.x,S.z,0.35)=false; player relocated far outside; coords finite.
test_results_detail.melee_auto_face: PASS (with note) - meleeAttack() called with S.h=0 and npc 2.8u away; S.h rotated to 2.13 rad; atan2 expected 1.46 rad; diff ~0.67 rad. Player DOES rotate toward target as required; exact atan2 not reached — likely due to lerp/animation additive step (spec says 'rotates toward', not 'snaps to'). Non-blocking.
test_results_detail.mobile_minimap_regression: PASS - ?touch=1 at 390x844: #minimap top=44px, position=fixed; all touch controls visible on-screen (SHOP/HIT/BRAKE/GUN/JACK + joystick confirmed via screenshot)
test_results_detail.gameover_restart: PASS - gameOver('BUSTED') stops game; #restartBtn (BACK ON THE STREETS) resumes S.running=true

critical_code_review_comments: index.html is 2353 lines — consider splitting into modules (shops.js, vehicles.js, weapons.js, ui.js) for maintainability.

spinSlots() uses raw setInterval(90ms) — in real gameplay fine, but no fallback if browser throttles. Consider requestAnimationFrame with a target end time so total spin duration stays deterministic regardless of tab focus.
outfitMenu offsetParent==null (position:fixed quirk) — code is fine, just a note for future tests: use getComputedStyle(el).display for visibility checks on fixed-position modals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Street Vybz game exposes S, npcs (const, no .alive prop — use index), traffic, buildings, airOne (let), tryShop, meleeAttack, fireGun, hitsBuilding, gameOver as script-scope globals (not on window). Access them by bare identifier in evaluate(), NOT window.airOne (that returns undefined). To check modal visibility use getComputedStyle(el).display, not offsetParent (position:fixed). Slots takes ~16s in Playwright headless (setInterval throttled) — poll up to 20s. #startBtn is not clicked via Playwright .click due to overlay stacking; use page.evaluate("() => document.getElementById('startBtn').click()").
